name: Gregory Pence
bio: a Representative from Indiana; born in Columbus, Bartholomew County, Ind., November 14, 1956; graduated from Columbus North High School, Columbus, Ind., 1975; B.A., Loyola University, Chicago, Ill., 1979; M.B.A., Loyola University, Chicago, Ill., 1985; United States Marine Corps., 1979-1983; engaged in the oil industry; retail consultant; small business owner; elected as a Republican to the One Hundred Sixteenth and to the two succeeding Congresses (January 3, 2019-January 3, 2025); was not a candidate for reelection to the One Hundred Nineteenth Congress in 2024.
